_readme: Customer stories for the homepage section 'Dentists who work with Haitech'.
Add each real clinician to 'stories' (copy the shape from '_template', which the site ignores).
Nothing appears on the live site until at least 3 entries pass every check in lib/customer-stories.ts.
An entry is held back automatically if published is false, any approval field is missing or false, the photo file does not exist, or reviewDueOn has passed.
Photos: a real photograph the clinician approved, saved in public/images/customers/ and referenced as /images/customers/<file>.
Quote: the clinician's own words about their experience, approved verbatim, max 240 characters. No patient-outcome or clinical-result claims.
materialConnection: write "none" only if no payment, gift, discount, free or loaned equipment, or other benefit was given. Otherwise describe it in plain language; it is shown next to the story.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Set reviewDueOn about 12 months after consent and re-confirm before then.
